description: Declarative affiliate catalog hygiene (C2.5.5). The catalog's canonical state is the production DB (affiliate_programs.match_terms); there is no version-controlled source and the CSV importer only inserts. Each change removes evidence-backed loose terms from ONE program, guarded by the exact expected current terms (before). Applied with scripts/apply_affiliate_catalog_hygiene.py (PLAN by default; --execute is all-or-nothing and idempotent). Strong terms (own name / alias) can never be removed. Terms with no live evidence are intentionally left for later review. Evidence: C2.5.2 catalog audit and C2.5.3 downstream audit.
